purpose: Record the exact implementation evidence for the adopted WV two-branch route mapping and identify the existing owner-correction transition required to clear PRODUCT_PATH_PENDING. This handoff does not grant packet, raster, terminal, commercial or production authority.

generator.statusSelection: routeMappingStatus is OWNER_DIRECTED_MAPPING_PENDING when routeMappingOpen and an execution reclassification exists

row.nextExecutableAction: Map the exact disposition fact to the correct SCA-C903 ground, refuse unclear records, and release the official-form build.
row.ownerDecision: This is route and field-election mapping.

observedEffect.legalInputStatus: SETTLED after the complete legal-resolution loader fix

historicalHold.why: SCA-C903: approved route-election mapping among acquittal, dismissal, diversion, and deferred-adjudication grounds
historicalHold.meaning: Historical lane evidence only. The remaining live PRODUCT_PATH_PENDING state is the owner execution reclassification above; the stale lane return is not itself a second legal decision.

adoptedDecision.scope: wv_nc_acquittal_dismissal-set: disposition-specific two-branch implementation under existing §61-11-25; no coverage reduction

adoptedBranches.DISMISSED_STRAIGHT: Use SCA-C903 only for an actual outright dismissal, with certified disposition facts and the printed dismissal ground.
adoptedBranches.ACQUITTED_OR_FOUND_NOT_GUILTY: Use the separate LegalEase §61-11-25 civil petition; never write an acquittal into SCA-C903 dismissal fields.
adoptedBranches.unclearOrMixed: Stop and refuse unsupported or conflicting records.
adoptedBranches.diversionOrDeferred: Remain in the separate wv_nc_diversion_deferred-set family.

routeWiringReviewedBySemanticReturn.dependencyComparison: The current working file contains an uncommitted binding-metadata addition after the semantic review. This handoff does not approve that later metadata change; the independent reviewer must compare it or review a frozen candidate before the transition is admitted.

requiredExistingTransition.authority: Existing OWNER_CORRECTIONS_REQUIRED execution-reclassification convention used by OR, KY, NE, PA and WI completions

completionEvidence.scope: Two-branch disposition mapping is implemented and independently semantically reviewed; this transition clears only the owner-directed mapping hold and preserves every packet, current-byte, raster, original-page, terminal and commercial gate.
completionEvidence.remainingGates: Current candidate metadata must be frozen and independently compared; central current-byte raster for all four branch fixtures, independent original-page review and Captain integration remain required. No packet PASS, terminal promotion, route release, commercial authority or production authorization is granted.

requiredExistingTransition.whyNotAppliedHere: The owner-correction row is an authoritative shared gate. This implementation handoff is frozen for independent review first; it does not silently clear the live state or claim that an independent reviewer approved the later uncommitted product-wiring metadata.

focusedChecks.command: source private/source-corpus-environment.txt && node --check scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/generate.mjs && node --check scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/legal-block-resolution.mjs && node --check scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/test-legal-block-resolution.mjs && node scripts/grade-a-packet-factory-24h/test-legal-block-resolution.mjs
findings: Complete loader projects the adopted WV record as LEGAL_CLEAR and does not include the separate diversion/deferred family.
The live owner execution row, rather than the stale PF13 lane return, is the direct source of PRODUCT_PATH_PENDING and OWNER_DIRECTED_MAPPING_PENDING.
PF08 native completeness is PASS_COMPLETE and VF44 route identity/options are PASS_PRE_RASTER_SEMANTIC.
The product wiring keeps generationAllowed and runtimeSelectable false.

requiredReview: Verify the exact adopted decision, PF08 build return, semantic return and branch artifact hashes.
Compare the reviewed product-wiring hash with the frozen candidate/current metadata before admitting the transition.
Confirm the proposed owner-row transition changes only stateOverride, preserves the completedStateOverride and historical hold, and leaves the diversion sibling outside scope.
Confirm no packet, raster, terminal, commercial or production authority is inferred.
reviewBoundary.currentStatus: Awaiting distinct independent review; live routeMappingStatus remains OWNER_DIRECTED_MAPPING_PENDING until that review and the existing owner-correction transition are completed.

result.exactRemainingWork: Distinct independent review of this handoff and the current candidate metadata; then apply the existing execution-reclassification completion pattern and run the supported integration. Central current-byte raster and original-page review remain downstream gates.
